description: We have seen the stark contrast between the Make America Great Again economy versus the Build Back Better economy that has been touted by the Biden-Harris Administration and legacy media. Despite efforts to convince hardworking Americans that inflation is not real, the people spoke on November 5th with a resounding roar that we will not continue down the same path.
